section_summary.extract_value: This section details the Body Appreciation Scale (BAS), a 13-item instrument used to measure positive body image, including its 5-point Likert-type scale and scoring. It discusses the scale's one-dimensional factor structure among women from Western settings and its lack of replication in non-Western women, which informed the sample selection to omit non-Western women. The section also highlights the scale's good test-retest reliability and construct/discriminant validity in college and community samples, and reports Cronbach's alphas of .92 for both US and non-US residents in the present study.
